entity: CMS Order and Referring file (Medicare's ordering-eligibility list)
why: The CMS methodology and Noridian pages are rule explainers (list = current PECOS enrollees; 13-month capped-rental grace), not measurements of the list, so they neither match nor contradict. The Senate PSI's 2008 finding that Medicare paid up to $92M for equipment 'prescribed' by dead doctors, and OIG's 2013 PECOS data-error finding, are the same kind of finding without our list.
